headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: ALO (12)

summary: Carlos Sainz won the Singapore Grand Prix from pole position, 0.8s ahead of Lando Norris, with Lewis Hamilton completing the podium.
Oscar Piastri made the biggest climb, from P17 to P7.
George Russell had a day to forget, dropping from P2 to P16.
The race was neutralised by 1 safety car and 1 virtual safety car.
The stewards penalised ALO (5 second time penalty).
There were 25 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Max Verstappen leads the championship by 151 points over Sergio Perez.
